rows.grounds: pīṭha (pedestal) + mantra (mantra) + anta (end), accusative singular neuter

items.question: From which power should one begin and where should one end in this rite?
items.inference: The practitioner proceeds from ādhāraśakti through pīṭhamantra.
uncertainties: Exact ritual scope beyond these endpoints is not stated.
items.plain_english: Beginning with the support-power, up to the pedestal-mantra, O Ambikā.
